contributions.statement: An env-free (no test execution) verifier used to filter SFT data matches env-based filtering for Python, Go, JavaScript and Java (within 2.5 points) but loses 7-13 points on compile-heavy Rust and C.
contributions.evidence: App. E Fig. 9 per-language breakdown; single training run each.

contributions.statement: When reviewing an agent patch against a reference (in SDD, possibly the spec's acceptance criteria), generate 2-4 targeted verification questions and answer each with a read-only grep subagent; this added only about 3 AUC points and requires a reference.
contributions.evidence: §4.4 Fig. 5: K=0 78.3 to K=4 81.0 AUC, plateau beyond 4; requires the gold patch; spec-as-reference untested.

reason: The core contribution is a training-time reward for model builders, which does not transfer to this team; the per-language result does not support a Java-specific compile-in-loop claim. Only a weak review-question idea remains as a hypothesis.
